content.json:
# Microsoft Security Value and Adoption
**Telemetry -> Detection -> Prevention -> Response -> Outcome**

This workbook reports observed security evidence. A zero can mean no matching events or missing telemetry; use **Evidence quality** before making an executive claim. Coverage percentages use observed inventories, not license assignment data.

## 00 - Executive KPI cards
**Security posture, threat protection, and response at a glance.** Advanced Hunting is off by default to protect the tenant CPU quota. Select **Run 30-day query** below to load the consolidated posture and threat card; response cards use the Sentinel workspace and the time selector. A 429 means the Defender tenant quota is exhausted and must reset before retrying.

### What this workbook proves
A unified view of Microsoft security value and adoption across four live data planes - no data movement and no extra ingestion.

| Evidence plane | What it answers | Pages |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Microsoft Sentinel Analytics** | Incidents, alerts, sign-ins, email, cloud, and SOC operations over the selected period | 01-09 |
| **Defender Advanced Hunting** | Endpoint, identity, email, cloud, and vulnerability truth over a native 30-day window, used where those tables are not ingested into Sentinel | 00, 03, 06, 10 |
| **Sentinel Data Lake** | Retained evidence across every workbook table over a selectable 30-365 day period | 11 |
| **Microsoft Graph** | Licensing, Secure Score, Conditional Access, MFA registration, device compliance, and identity governance that never appears in security logs | 12 |

**Section map:** 00 KPI cards -> 01 Executive -> 02 Adoption -> 03 Prevented -> 04 XDR -> 05 Identity -> 06 Endpoint -> 07 Email -> 08 SOC -> 09 Roadmap -> 10 Hunting -> 11 Data Lake -> 12 Microsoft Graph.

**How to read it:** counts are labeled by event type and never summed into one inflated "threats stopped" number; a zero can mean no matching events or telemetry not ingested (check **Evidence quality** on page 01); coverage uses observed inventories, and licensing/policy truth comes from the Microsoft Graph section.

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"let D = materialize(DeviceInfo
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, OnboardingStatus, SensorHealthState, ExposureLevel
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, OnboardingStatus, SensorHealthState, ExposureLevel) by DeviceId);
let I = materialize(IdentityInfo
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | project Timestamp, AccountObjectId, IsAccountEnabled, RiskLevel
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, IsAccountEnabled, RiskLevel) by AccountObjectId
    | where IsAccountEnabled);
let A = materialize(AlertInfo
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | project AlertId, Title, Category, AttackTechniques);
let E = materialize(EmailEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d) and DeliveryAction in~ ('Blocked','Junked','Replaced')
    | project NetworkMessageId, ThreatTypes);
union
(D | summarize Total=count(), Prot=countif(OnboardingStatus =~ 'Onboarded' and SensorHealthState !in~ ('Inactive','NoSensorData')) | extend Value=round(100.0 * Prot / iff(Total == 0, real(null), toreal(Total)), 1), Metric='Devices protected %', Context='Posture - onboarded and healthy' | project Metric, Value, Context),
(I | summarize Total=count(), Prot=countif(RiskLevel !~ 'High') | extend Value=round(100.0 * Prot / iff(Total == 0, real(null), toreal(Total)), 1), Metric='Identities protected %', Context='Posture - enabled, not high-risk' | project Metric, Value, Context),
(D | summarize Value=todouble(count()) | extend Metric='Devices discovered', Context='Posture - latest inventory' | project Metric, Value, Context),
(I | summarize Value=todouble(count()) | extend Metric='Enabled identities', Context='Posture - latest inventory' | project Metric, Value, Context),
(D | summarize Value=todouble(countif(ExposureLevel =~ 'High' or SensorHealthState in~ ('Inactive','NoSensorData') or OnboardingStatus !~ 'Onboarded')) | extend Metric='High-risk assets unprotected', Context='Posture - high exposure, unhealthy, or not onboarded' | project Metric, Value, Context),
(I | summarize Value=todouble(countif(RiskLevel =~ 'High')) | extend Metric='High-risk identities unprotected', Context='Posture - enabled and high-risk' | project Metric, Value, Context),
(A | summarize Value=todouble(dcount(AlertId)) | extend Metric='Threats detected (30d)', Context='Protection - distinct XDR alerts'),
(A | summarize Value=todouble(dcountif(AlertId, Title contains 'malware' or Title contains 'trojan' or Title contains 'virus' or Title contains 'backdoor' or Title contains 'worm')) | extend Metric='Malware detections', Context='Malware-related alerts'),
(A | summarize Value=todouble(dcountif(AlertId, Category == 'CredentialAccess')) | extend Metric='Credential attacks', Context='Credential access alerts'),
(A | summarize Value=todouble(dcountif(AlertId, Title contains 'ransom' or Title contains 'Safe Mode' or Title contains 'shadow copy' or Title contains 'backups were deleted' or Title contains 'recovery setting' or AttackTechniques contains 'T1486' or AttackTechniques contains 'T1490')) | extend Metric='Ransomware detections', Context='Ransomware-related alerts'),
(E | where ThreatTypes has 'Phish' | summarize Value=todouble(dcount(NetworkMessageId)) | extend Metric='Phishing blocked', Context='Blocked or diverted email'),
(E | where ThreatTypes has 'Malware' | summarize Value=todouble(dcount(NetworkMessageId)) | extend Metric='Malware email blocked', Context='Blocked or diverted email'),
(DeviceEvents | where Timestamp > ago(30d) and (ActionType contains 'Block' or ActionType contains 'Quarantine' or ActionType contains 'Prevent' or ActionType contains 'Remediat' or ActionType contains 'Isolat') | summarize Value=todouble(count()) | extend Metric='Endpoint threats blocked', Context='Endpoint protection actions'),
(CloudAppEvents | where Timestamp > ago(30d) and (ActionType contains 'Block' or ActionType contains 'Suspend' or ActionType contains 'Quarantine') | summarize Value=todouble(count()) | extend Metric='Cloud attacks blocked', Context='Cloud app enforcement'),
(A | summarize Value=todouble(dcountif(AlertId, Title contains 'attack disruption' or Title contains 'containment' or Title contains 'contained' or Title contains 'blocked on multiple')) | extend Metric='Attack disruption alerts', Context='Attack disruption / containment')
| project Metric, Value, Context","selectedWorkspaceIds":[]}
content.title: Security posture and threat protection (30 days)

content.query:
let Incidents = union isfuzzy=true (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, IncidentNumber:int, CreatedTime:datetime, ClosedTime:datetime, FirstActivityTime:datetime, Severity:string, Status:string, Owner:dynamic)[]), (SecurityIncident | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | project TimeGenerated, IncidentNumber, CreatedTime, ClosedTime, FirstActivityTime, Severity, Status, Owner) | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber;
let SevMap = Incidents | extend SevScore=case(Severity =~ 'High', 3.0, Severity =~ 'Medium', 2.0, Severity =~ 'Low', 1.0, Severity =~ 'Informational', 0.0, real(null));
union
(Incidents | where isnotnull(FirstActivityTime) | summarize Value=round(avg(datetime_diff('minute', CreatedTime, FirstActivityTime))/60.0, 1) | extend Metric='MTTD (hours)', Context='Create lag from first activity'),
(Incidents | where Status =~ 'Closed' and isnotnull(ClosedTime) | summarize Value=round(avg(datetime_diff('minute', ClosedTime, CreatedTime))/60.0, 1) | extend Metric='MTTR (hours)', Context='Closed incidents'),
(SevMap | summarize Value=round(avg(SevScore), 2) | extend Metric='Average incident severity', Context='High=3, Med=2, Low=1'),
(Incidents | summarize Value=todouble(countif(isnotempty(tostring(Owner)) and Status !~ 'Closed')) | extend Metric='Incidents needing analyst', Context='Assigned and still open'),
(Incidents | summarize Value=todouble(count()) | extend Metric='Incidents (period)', Context='Unique latest state'),
(Incidents | summarize Value=todouble(countif(Status =~ 'Closed')) | extend Metric='Incidents closed', Context='Observed state')
| project Metric, Value, Context
content.title: Response

content.json:
### Now populated live from Microsoft Graph (page 12)
These adoption KPIs are not in security logs and are served live from the Microsoft Graph section:
- License utilization - assigned vs available Microsoft 365, Copilot, and Defender seats
- Secure Score and improvement recommendations
- Conditional Access policy coverage
- MFA and authentication method registration
- Intune device compliance
- Guest / external accounts and risky users

## 01 - Executive Security Value
**Are we protected, and what outcomes are being achieved?**

### Workbook capabilities
This workbook provides four complementary evidence paths for security value and adoption assessment:

| Capability | What it demonstrates | Evidence source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Executive outcomes | Incidents, severity, closure, correlation, and observed protection outcomes | Microsoft Sentinel Analytics |
| Security adoption | Telemetry presence, freshness, inventory coverage, and capability maturity | Sentinel and connected Defender data |
| Threat prevention | Endpoint actions, blocked or remediated email, interrupted risky sign-ins, and alert coverage | Sentinel and Defender telemetry |
| Defender XDR | Cross-workload alerts, endpoint health, identity risk, email protection, cloud activity, disruption, and vulnerabilities | Live Advanced Hunting data source (30 days) |
| SOC effectiveness | Backlog, ownership, resolution time, classifications, and automation activity | Sentinel incidents and response logs |
| Improvement roadmap | Evidence-backed security gaps plus missing licensing, policy, Purview, Intune, posture, and operational inputs | Telemetry and administrative exports |
| Long-term evidence | Selectable 30-365 day incident, alert, identity, endpoint, email, cloud, and network evidence across all workbook tables | Sentinel Data Lake |

Use **Evidence quality** before presenting any metric. “Not observed” can mean missing, stale, or unconnected telemetry and does not prove that a capability is unlicensed.

content.title: Observed security outcomes

content.query:
let Incidents = union isfuzzy=true (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, IncidentNumber:int, Status:string)[]), (SecurityIncident | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | project TimeGenerated, IncidentNumber, Status);
Incidents
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| summarize Detected=count(), Closed=countif(Status =~ 'Closed') by Day=bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| order by Day asc
content.title: Incidents detected and closed

content.query:
let expected = datatable(TableName:string, Capability:string) [
  'SecurityIncident','Sentinel incidents', 'SecurityAlert','Sentinel alerts', 'SigninLogs','Entra sign-ins',
  'IdentityInfo','Identity inventory', 'DeviceInfo','Defender for Endpoint', 'DeviceEvents','Endpoint protection actions',
  'EmailEvents','Defender for Office 365', 'EmailPostDeliveryEvents','Email remediation', 'CloudAppEvents','Defender for Cloud Apps'
];
let observed = union isfuzzy=true
(SecurityIncident | summarize LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) | extend TableName='SecurityIncident'),
(SecurityAlert | summarize LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) | extend TableName='SecurityAlert'),
(SigninLogs | summarize LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) | extend TableName='SigninLogs'),
(IdentityInfo | summarize LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) | extend TableName='IdentityInfo'),
(DeviceInfo | summarize LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) | extend TableName='DeviceInfo'),
(DeviceEvents | summarize LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) | extend TableName='DeviceEvents'),
(EmailEvents | summarize LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) | extend TableName='EmailEvents'),
(EmailPostDeliveryEvents | summarize LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) | extend TableName='EmailPostDeliveryEvents'),
(CloudAppEvents | summarize LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) | extend TableName='CloudAppEvents')
| project TableName, LastSeen;
expected
| join kind=leftouter observed on TableName
| extend EvidenceState=case(isnull(LastSeen),'Not observed', LastSeen < ago(2d),'Stale','Current')
| project Capability, TableName, EvidenceState, LastSeen
| order by EvidenceState asc, Capability asc
content.title: Evidence quality - validate before presenting

content.json:
## 02 - Security Coverage and Adoption
**Licensed is not the same as configured, collecting, detecting, and responding.** License availability requires Microsoft Graph or licensing export and is intentionally not inferred from logs.

content.query:
let signals = union isfuzzy=true
(SecurityIncident | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize Records=count(), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) | extend Capability='Microsoft Sentinel', Stage='Detecting and responding'),
(AlertInfo | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize Records=count(), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) | extend Capability='Defender XDR', Stage='Detecting'),
(DeviceInfo | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize Records=dcount(DeviceId), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) | extend Capability='Defender for Endpoint', Stage='Collecting telemetry'),
(DeviceEvents | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize Records=count(), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) | extend Capability='Endpoint protection actions', Stage='Responding'),
(EmailEvents | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize Records=count(), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) | extend Capability='Defender for Office 365', Stage='Collecting telemetry'),
(EmailPostDeliveryEvents | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize Records=count(), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) | extend Capability='Office 365 remediation', Stage='Responding'),
(SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize Records=count(), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) | extend Capability='Entra ID Protection', Stage='Collecting telemetry'),
(IdentityInfo | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize Records=dcount(AccountObjectId), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) | extend Capability='Defender for Identity', Stage='Collecting telemetry'),
(CloudAppEvents | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize Records=count(), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) | extend Capability='Defender for Cloud Apps', Stage='Collecting telemetry');
signals
| extend Telemetry=iff(Records > 0,'Observed','Not observed'), Freshness=case(LastSeen > ago(2d),'Current',LastSeen > ago(7d),'Aging','Stale')
| extend Maturity=case(Records == 0,'0 - Not evidenced', Stage contains 'Responding','4 - Responding', Stage contains 'Detecting','3 - Detecting','2 - Collecting')
| project Capability, Telemetry, Records, LastSeen, Freshness, Maturity
| order by Capability asc
content.title: Telemetry-driven capability maturity

content.query:
let Devices = union isfuzzy=true (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, DeviceId:string, OnboardingStatus:string, SensorHealthState:string)[]), (DeviceInfo | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | project TimeGenerated, DeviceId, OnboardingStatus, SensorHealthState) | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId;
let Identities = union isfuzzy=true (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, AccountObjectId:string, IsAccountEnabled:bool, RiskLevel:string)[]), (IdentityInfo | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | project TimeGenerated, AccountObjectId, IsAccountEnabled, RiskLevel) | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AccountObjectId;
union
(Devices | summarize Total=count(), Protected=countif(OnboardingStatus =~ 'Onboarded' and SensorHealthState !in~ ('Inactive','NoSensorData')) | extend Surface='Endpoints'),
(Identities | where IsAccountEnabled | summarize Total=count(), Protected=countif(RiskLevel !~ 'high') | extend Surface='Enabled identities without high risk')
| extend CoveragePct=round(100.0 * Protected / iff(Total == 0, real(null), toreal(Total)), 1)
| project Surface, Protected, Total, CoveragePct
content.title: Observed inventory coverage

content.json:
## 03 - Threats Prevented
**What did Microsoft detect, block, divert, or contain?** Counts are labeled by event type and are not added into one inflated total.

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true
(EmailEvents | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where isnotempty(ThreatTypes) and DeliveryAction in~ ('Blocked','Junked','Replaced') | summarize Value=dcount(NetworkMessageId) | extend Metric='Threat emails blocked or diverted', Context='Unique messages'),
(EmailPostDeliveryEvents | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where ActionResult =~ 'Success' | summarize Value=dcount(NetworkMessageId) | extend Metric='Post-delivery remediations', Context='Successful unique-message actions'),
(SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where RiskLevelDuringSignIn in~ ('medium','high') and (ConditionalAccessStatus =~ 'failure' or ResultType != '0') | summarize Value=count() | extend Metric='Risky sign-ins interrupted', Context='Observed failed or CA-blocked'),
(SecurityAlert | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize Value=dcount(SystemAlertId) | extend Metric='Threat detections', Context='Unique Sentinel alerts')
| project Metric, Value, Context
content.title: Observed prevention and containment actions

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"let E = DeviceEvents | where Timestamp > ago(30d);
union
(E | where ActionType contains 'Antivirus' | summarize Value=todouble(count()) | extend Metric='AV detections/reports', Context='Defender Antivirus'),
(E | where ActionType contains 'Asr' | summarize Value=todouble(count()) | extend Metric='ASR blocks', Context='Attack surface reduction'),
(E | where ActionType contains 'ExploitGuard' | summarize Value=todouble(count()) | extend Metric='Exploit Guard', Context='Exploit protection'),
(E | where ActionType contains 'Block' or ActionType contains 'Quarantine' or ActionType contains 'Remediat' or ActionType contains 'Isolat' | summarize Value=todouble(count()) | extend Metric='Blocks/remediations', Context='Containment actions')
| project Metric, Value, Context","selectedWorkspaceIds":[]}
content.title: Endpoint protection actions (Advanced Hunting, 30 days)

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true
(EmailEvents | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where isnotempty(ThreatTypes) and DeliveryAction in~ ('Blocked','Junked','Replaced') | summarize Actions=dcount(NetworkMessageId) by Domain='Email'),
(SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where RiskLevelDuringSignIn in~ ('medium','high') and (ConditionalAccessStatus =~ 'failure' or ResultType != '0') | summarize Actions=count() by Domain='Identity'),
(CloudAppEvents | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where ActionType has_any ('Block','Suspend','Quarantine') | summarize Actions=count() by Domain='Cloud apps'),
(datatable(Domain:string, Actions:long)[])
| order by Actions desc
content.title: Protection actions by security domain

content.query:
let Alerts = union isfuzzy=true (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, AlertName:string, Tactics:string, Techniques:string)[]), (SecurityAlert | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | project TimeGenerated, AlertName, Tactics, Techniques);
Alerts
| mv-expand Tactic=split(Tactics, ',') to typeof(string)
| extend Tactic=trim(' ', Tactic)
| where isnotempty(Tactic)
| summarize Alerts=count(), Detections=dcount(AlertName), TechniquesObserved=dcount(Techniques) by Tactic
| order by Alerts desc
content.title: MITRE ATT&CK tactics observed in alerts

content.json:
## 04 - Defender XDR
**How effectively are endpoint, identity, email, and cloud signals correlated?**

content.query:
let Incidents = union isfuzzy=true (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, IncidentNumber:int, ProductNames:dynamic, Severity:string, Status:string)[]), (SecurityIncident | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | extend ProductNames=coalesce(todynamic(AdditionalData.alertProductNames), dynamic([])) | project TimeGenerated, IncidentNumber, ProductNames, Severity, Status) | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber;
Incidents
| extend WorkloadCount=array_length(ProductNames)
| summarize TotalIncidents=count(), CrossDomain=countif(WorkloadCount >= 2), HighSeverity=countif(Severity =~ 'High'), Closed=countif(Status =~ 'Closed'), AvgWorkloads=round(avg(todouble(WorkloadCount)),2)
| extend CrossDomainPct=round(100.0 * CrossDomain / iff(TotalIncidents == 0, real(null), toreal(TotalIncidents)),1)
content.title: Cross-domain incident correlation

content.query:
let Incidents = union isfuzzy=true (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, IncidentNumber:int, ProductNames:dynamic)[]), (SecurityIncident | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | extend ProductNames=coalesce(todynamic(AdditionalData.alertProductNames), dynamic([])) | project TimeGenerated, IncidentNumber, ProductNames) | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber;
Incidents
| mv-expand Workload=ProductNames to typeof(string)
| where isnotempty(Workload)
| summarize Incidents=dcount(IncidentNumber) by Workload
| order by Incidents desc
content.title: Workloads represented in incidents

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true
(AlertInfo | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize Alerts=dcount(AlertId) by ServiceSource, Severity),
(SecurityAlert | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize Alerts=dcount(SystemAlertId) by ServiceSource=ProductName, Severity=AlertSeverity)
| summarize Alerts=sum(Alerts) by ServiceSource, Severity
| order by Alerts desc
content.title: Alerts by source and severity

content.json:
## 05 - Identity and Entra Protection
**Are risky identities and authentications being identified and interrupted?**

content.query:
let Signins = union isfuzzy=true (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, Id:string, UserId:string, RiskLevelDuringSignIn:string, ConditionalAccessStatus:string, ResultType:string, AuthenticationRequirement:string)[]), (SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | project TimeGenerated, Id, UserId, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, ConditionalAccessStatus, ResultType, AuthenticationRequirement);
let Identities = union isfuzzy=true (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, AccountObjectId:string, IsAccountEnabled:bool, RiskLevel:string, AssignedRoles:dynamic)[]), (IdentityInfo | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | project TimeGenerated, AccountObjectId, IsAccountEnabled, RiskLevel, AssignedRoles) | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AccountObjectId;
union
(Identities | where IsAccountEnabled | summarize Value=count() | extend Metric='Enabled identities', Context='Latest observed inventory'),
(Identities | where IsAccountEnabled and RiskLevel =~ 'high' | summarize Value=count() | extend Metric='High-risk identities', Context='Requires remediation'),
(Signins | where RiskLevelDuringSignIn in~ ('medium','high') | summarize Value=count() | extend Metric='Risky sign-ins', Context='Observed sign-in risk'),
(Signins | where RiskLevelDuringSignIn in~ ('medium','high') and (ConditionalAccessStatus =~ 'failure' or ResultType != '0') | summarize Value=count() | extend Metric='Risky sign-ins interrupted', Context='Failed or CA-blocked'),
(Signins | summarize Value=countif(AuthenticationRequirement =~ 'multiFactorAuthentication') | extend Metric='MFA-required sign-ins', Context='Observed sign-ins, not user registration coverage'),
(Identities | where array_length(AssignedRoles) > 0 | summarize Value=count() | extend Metric='Privileged identities observed', Context='Assigned role inventory')
| project Metric, Value, Context
content.title: Identity protection evidence

content.query:
let Signins = union isfuzzy=true (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, RiskLevelDuringSignIn:string, ConditionalAccessStatus:string, ResultType:string)[]), (SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | project TimeGenerated, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, ConditionalAccessStatus, ResultType);
Signins
| summarize Risky=countif(RiskLevelDuringSignIn in~ ('medium','high')), Interrupted=countif(RiskLevelDuringSignIn in~ ('medium','high') and (ConditionalAccessStatus =~ 'failure' or ResultType != '0')) by Day=bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| order by Day asc
content.title: Risky and interrupted sign-ins

## 07 - Email and Cloud Protection
**How much phishing, malware, and cloud activity is being detected or remediated?**

content.query:
let Mail = union isfuzzy=true (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, NetworkMessageId:string, ThreatTypes:string, DeliveryAction:string)[]), (EmailEvents | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | project TimeGenerated, NetworkMessageId, ThreatTypes, DeliveryAction);
union
(Mail | summarize Value=dcount(NetworkMessageId) | extend Metric='Messages analyzed', Context='Unique observed messages'),
(Mail | where ThreatTypes has 'Phish' | summarize Value=dcount(NetworkMessageId) | extend Metric='Phishing detected', Context='Unique messages'),
(Mail | where ThreatTypes has 'Malware' | summarize Value=dcount(NetworkMessageId) | extend Metric='Malware detected', Context='Unique messages'),
(Mail | where isnotempty(ThreatTypes) and DeliveryAction in~ ('Blocked','Junked','Replaced') | summarize Value=dcount(NetworkMessageId) | extend Metric='Threats blocked or diverted', Context='Unique messages'),
(EmailPostDeliveryEvents | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and ActionResult =~ 'Success' | summarize Value=dcount(NetworkMessageId) | extend Metric='Post-delivery remediation', Context='Successful unique-message actions'),
(CloudAppEvents | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize Value=count() | extend Metric='Cloud app activities', Context='Observed activities')
| project Metric, Value, Context
content.title: Email and cloud protection evidence

content.query:
let Mail = union isfuzzy=true (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, NetworkMessageId:string, ThreatTypes:string, DeliveryAction:string)[]), (EmailEvents | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | project TimeGenerated, NetworkMessageId, ThreatTypes, DeliveryAction);
Mail
| where isnotempty(ThreatTypes)
| summarize Messages=dcount(NetworkMessageId) by ThreatTypes, DeliveryAction
| order by Messages desc
content.title: Threat messages by verdict and action

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true
(CloudAppEvents | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize Activities=count(), Users=dcount(AccountObjectId) by Application, ActionType),
(datatable(Application:string, ActionType:string, Activities:long, Users:long)[])

content.json:
## 08 - SOC Efficiency and Automation
**Is Microsoft reducing analyst workload and resolution time?** Analyst-hours-saved is excluded unless an organization-approved effort model is supplied.

content.query:
let Incidents = union isfuzzy=true (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, IncidentNumber:int, CreatedTime:datetime, ClosedTime:datetime, Status:string, Classification:string, Owner:dynamic)[]), (SecurityIncident | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | project TimeGenerated, IncidentNumber, CreatedTime, ClosedTime, Status, Classification, Owner) | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber;
union
(Incidents | summarize Value=toreal(count()) | extend Metric='Incidents', Context='Unique latest state'),
(Incidents | where Status =~ 'Closed' | summarize Value=toreal(count()) | extend Metric='Closed incidents', Context='Observed state'),
(Incidents | where Status !~ 'Closed' | summarize Value=toreal(count()) | extend Metric='Open backlog', Context='Observed state'),
(Incidents | where Status =~ 'Closed' and isnotnull(ClosedTime) | summarize Value=round(avg(datetime_diff('minute',ClosedTime,CreatedTime))/60.0,1) | extend Metric='Mean time to resolve (hours)', Context='Closed incidents with timestamps'),
(Incidents | where Classification =~ 'FalsePositive' | summarize Value=toreal(count()) | extend Metric='False-positive closures', Context='Analyst classification'),

## 09 - Gaps and Improvement Roadmap
**Where should adoption increase next?** Prioritize enable -> configure -> expand -> automate.

content.query:
let Devices = union isfuzzy=true (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, DeviceId:string, OnboardingStatus:string, SensorHealthState:string, ExposureLevel:string)[]), (DeviceInfo | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | project TimeGenerated, DeviceId, OnboardingStatus, SensorHealthState, ExposureLevel) | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId;
let Identities = union isfuzzy=true (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, AccountObjectId:string, IsAccountEnabled:bool, RiskLevel:string)[]), (IdentityInfo | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | project TimeGenerated, AccountObjectId, IsAccountEnabled, RiskLevel) | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AccountObjectId;
union
(Devices | where OnboardingStatus !~ 'Onboarded' | summarize GapCount=count() | extend Priority='High', Gap='Devices not onboarded to MDE', RecommendedAction='Enable and onboard'),
(Devices | where SensorHealthState in~ ('Inactive','NoSensorData') | summarize GapCount=count() | extend Priority='High', Gap='MDE sensors unhealthy', RecommendedAction='Restore telemetry'),
(Devices | where ExposureLevel =~ 'High' | summarize GapCount=count() | extend Priority='High', Gap='High-exposure devices', RecommendedAction='Prioritize remediation'),
(Identities | where IsAccountEnabled and RiskLevel =~ 'high' | summarize GapCount=count() | extend Priority='High', Gap='Enabled high-risk identities', RecommendedAction='Investigate and remediate'),
(SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and RiskLevelDuringSignIn in~ ('medium','high') and ConditionalAccessStatus !~ 'failure' and ResultType == '0' | summarize GapCount=count() | extend Priority='High', Gap='Risky sign-ins not interrupted', RecommendedAction='Expand Conditional Access'),
(EmailEvents | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and isnotempty(ThreatTypes) and DeliveryAction =~ 'Delivered' | summarize GapCount=dcount(NetworkMessageId) | extend Priority='Medium', Gap='Threat email initially delivered', RecommendedAction='Review protection policies and ZAP'),
(SentinelHealth | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Status !~ 'Success' | summarize GapCount=count() | extend Priority='Medium', Gap='Sentinel health failures or warnings', RecommendedAction='Restore connector or rule health')
| where GapCount > 0
| project Priority, Gap, GapCount, RecommendedAction
| order by Priority asc, GapCount desc

content.json:
### Evidence still required outside security telemetry
- **Licensing:** assigned, available, active-use, and eligible-user counts from Microsoft Graph or the Microsoft 365 admin center.
- **Identity controls:** Conditional Access policy coverage, exclusions, authentication-method registration, and break-glass testing.
- **Data security:** Purview DLP, Information Protection, Insider Risk, eDiscovery, and audit adoption evidence.
- **Device governance:** Intune enrollment, compliance, configuration baselines, and unmanaged-device population.
- **Posture and operations:** Secure Score recommendation history, service costs, and an approved analyst-effort baseline.

These gaps prevent telemetry counts from being presented as complete license utilization or business-outcome evidence.

### Executive interpretation guardrails
- **Observed** means the selected workspace contains matching telemetry in the selected period.
- **Not observed** does not prove a feature is unlicensed or disabled.
- Do not sum alerts, blocked messages, sign-ins, and endpoint actions into one “threats stopped” number; they have different units and can describe the same attack.
- Coverage is based on the latest observed inventory. Add Microsoft Graph license and policy data for a complete adoption view.
- Any analyst-hours-saved estimate must disclose the assumed minutes per action and should be shown separately from observed metrics.

## 11 - Sentinel Data Lake
**Query retained security evidence over a selectable 30, 60, 90, 180, or 365-day period.** Start with 30 days for faster results, then expand the range only when needed. This page uses its own **Data Lake period**, independent of the global time selector. Select the Data Lake workspace in each tile after import, then save; the workspace selector is intentionally unset for portability.

Tiles use lightweight `count`/`countif` aggregations because workbook Data Lake tiles run synchronously and cannot run as background jobs. Longer periods can still time out in high-volume workspaces. For exact distinct counts or heavier analysis, run the same query in the native Data Lake KQL exploration experience, which supports long-running and scheduled jobs. A blank or error result means the table might not be onboarded or retained in the lake; it does not prove that no activity occurred.

content.query:
{"workspaces":[],"query":"let expected = datatable(TableName:string, Capability:string) [
  'SecurityIncident','Sentinel incidents', 'SecurityAlert','Sentinel alerts', 'SigninLogs','Entra sign-ins',
  'IdentityInfo','Identity inventory', 'DeviceInfo','Defender for Endpoint', 'DeviceEvents','Endpoint protection actions',
  'DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities','Vulnerability exposure', 'EmailEvents','Defender for Office 365',
  'EmailPostDeliveryEvents','Email remediation', 'CloudAppEvents','Defender for Cloud Apps',
  'CommonSecurityLog','Network security', 'AzureActivity','Azure control plane', 'SentinelHealth','Sentinel health'
];
let observed = union isfuzzy=true
(SecurityIncident | where TimeGenerated > ago({DataLakeRange}) | summarize Records=count(), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) | extend TableName='SecurityIncident'),
(SecurityAlert | where TimeGenerated > ago({DataLakeRange}) | summarize Records=count(), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) | extend TableName='SecurityAlert'),
(SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago({DataLakeRange}) | summarize Records=count(), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) | extend TableName='SigninLogs'),
(IdentityInfo | where TimeGenerated > ago({DataLakeRange}) | summarize Records=count(), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) | extend TableName='IdentityInfo'),
(DeviceInfo | where TimeGenerated > ago({DataLakeRange}) | summarize Records=count(), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) | extend TableName='DeviceInfo'),
(DeviceEvents | where TimeGenerated > ago({DataLakeRange}) | summarize Records=count(), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) | extend TableName='DeviceEvents'),
(DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities | where TimeGenerated > ago({DataLakeRange}) | summarize Records=count(), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) | extend TableName='DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities'),
(EmailEvents | where TimeGenerated > ago({DataLakeRange}) | summarize Records=count(), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) | extend TableName='EmailEvents'),
(EmailPostDeliveryEvents | where TimeGenerated > ago({DataLakeRange}) | summarize Records=count(), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) | extend TableName='EmailPostDeliveryEvents'),
(CloudAppEvents | where TimeGenerated > ago({DataLakeRange}) | summarize Records=count(), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) | extend TableName='CloudAppEvents'),
(CommonSecurityLog | where TimeGenerated > ago({DataLakeRange}) | summarize Records=count(), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) | extend TableName='CommonSecurityLog'),
(AzureActivity | where TimeGenerated > ago({DataLakeRange}) | summarize Records=count(), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) | extend TableName='AzureActivity'),
(SentinelHealth | where TimeGenerated > ago({DataLakeRange}) | summarize Records=count(), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) | extend TableName='SentinelHealth')
| project TableName, Records, LastSeen;
expected
| join kind=leftouter observed on TableName
| extend Records=coalesce(Records, 0), Evidence=iff(isnull(LastSeen),'Not retained in lake','Retained')
| project Capability, TableName, Records, LastSeen, Evidence
| order by Records desc"}
